task.title: Authenticate over SSH
task.shortdesc: Connect to an SSH remote using your SSH keys, optionally through an SSH agent.

context.p: For SSH remotes, the Git Client authenticates with your SSH key. It can use a running SSH agent so you do not retype your passphrase, and it supports ssh-agent forwarding.

step.cmd: Select to authenticate through an agent.

info.p: On Windows, choose the agent to use:
On Linux, macOS, and BSD, the Git Client communicates with the agent through the standard Unix domain socket.

result.p: The Git Client uses the keys held by the agent for SSH operations. If a key is protected by a passphrase and no agent is available, it prompts you for the passphrase.
